text: Added an Appearance setting (System, Light, Dark) to the header settings popover, stored in localStorage as `yt.theme` and written to `<html data-theme>`. A new `src/theme.ts` hook manages it, and an inline script in `index.html` applies it before first paint. `styles.css` keys the dark tokens on `[data-theme="dark"]` with a system fallback, and shadcn's `dark:` variant now follows the chosen theme. Typecheck and the UI build pass. A Playwright run with the OS set to light confirmed Dark applies immediately, survives a reload from first paint, and System follows OS changes. Design doc updated; committed as 03e0624, not pushed.
